caveat: SEC EDGAR's own endpoints, relayed unread. `companyfacts` is the whole XBRL history of a filer — every us-gaap tag it has ever reported, each with its own filing dates in the vendor's fields. Nothing here is bounded by asOf and nothing is dated by Aumos: reading the dates out of the document is the caller's work. SEC requires a contactable caller, which is what the credential is.
